description: Get a single property by its Straply ID (an opaque string like 'stp_x7Kd9Qm2Rb', as returned by search_properties). Returns the full property record including address, price, beds/baths, square footage, year built, lot size, property type, listing status, price history (all listing/sale/price-change events), and tax history.
name: get_property
title: Get property
